race.comment: I'VE FORGOTTEN (13) is the main danger, with his Wagga Riverside Mdn win two back reading well and his Wodonga defeat last start carrying excuses after he was held up and raced wide. Look for an improved run. SHAPENAPIT (3) comes off back-to-back seconds and keeps holding her form. Can give this a shake. PALLADIUM (2) is back after five months from stronger Flemington form. Finds a suitable race to kick off the prep on the right note. SAKER FALCON (8) was better than the Wodonga result after being forced wide, gets weight relief and has enough 1400m exposure to keep him in the discussion. Include in wider plays.
